title: StructureParameters
description:
A nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameter set for the native structure kernel.

DEP-STRU-001. AMD-009 verified the licence position of the folding *code* and prescribed a permissively-licensed kernel; it said nothing about the parameter set that kernel needs to compute anything. Published sets are embedded in tools whose licences are exactly what AMD-009 rejects, so a kernel shipping a table would either carry fabricated values - which the no-fabricated-constants rule forbids - or redistribute data whose terms nobody on the project has verified.

So parameters are input data, following the host-profile and model-artifact pattern: the user supplies a document, it carries its own provenance, and its digest is recorded in the landscape lockfile so two runs cannot silently use different thermodynamics. A run with no parameter set is refused with CF-STRU-001 rather than falling back to a default.

The schema deliberately cannot tell a real parameter set from a well-formed invented one - no schema can. What it *can* do is refuse a set that does not say where it came from, which is why `provenance` is required and its fields are not nullable.

parameter_set_id.description: Stable identifier, versioned. Changing any energy changes every fold, so a new set is a new id rather than an edit.

provenance.description: Where these numbers came from. Required, and required to be specific: 'a schema that validates a well-formed but fabricated parameter set' is the failure this document exists to prevent, and the only defence a machine can offer is refusing a set that declines to say.

citation.description: Full bibliographic citation of the measurements. A DOI alone is not enough for a reader with no network.

source_digest.description: Digest of the source file the values were transcribed from, so a transcription can be re-checked against the thing it came from.

licence.description: The licence the supplier holds these values under. Recorded rather than assumed: AMD-009 exists because a licence nobody checked turned out to forbid the distribution the project assumed.

redistributable.description: Whether the supplier believes this set may be redistributed. CodonForge records the claim and never acts on it by vendoring - the set stays user-supplied either way.

temperature_k.description: Temperature the parameters were measured at, in kelvin. The kernel is temperature-parameterized, and extrapolating from an unrecorded reference temperature is how a fold becomes confidently wrong.

stack.description: Nearest-neighbour stacking free energies in kcal/mol, keyed by the two base pairs as '5'XY3'/3'WZ5''. No default: an absent entry is refused at use, naming the pair.

hairpin_loop.description: Hairpin initiation free energies by unpaired loop length.

digest.description: Digest of this document with `digest` omitted, and with `created_at` omitted per DEP-VER-003. This is the value recorded in the landscape lockfile.
